parsed.rationale: The cluster surfaces two near-duplicate HEIF-encoding routines — `encodeCGImageAsHEIF` in package `Artwork` (CachingArtworkFetcher.swift:75) and `Image.heifData` in package `Core` (ImageCompatability.swift:107) — with a Jaccard similarity of 0.71, indicating substantial shared logic. `Core` is the natural canonical home because it already owns the image-compatibility surface (`ImageCompatability.swift`) and `Artwork` depends on `Core` (not the reverse), satisfying the upstream-of-every-consumer constraint. The `encodeCGImageAsHEIF` free function in `Artwork` should be deleted and its call sites redirected to `Image.heifData` in `Core`, eliminating the duplication without introducing a new package.
